dataset.product_assignment: single-product tomato interpretation of every existing kg demand; declared numerical scenario, not observed orders

routing.source: pinned author VRPTWQ README Fleet table
routing.max_vehicles_rule: required CLI parameter; experimental upper bound, not a source fleet size
routing.departure_policy: all used vehicles leave at depot TW_START; each vehicle has an independent clock
routing.cost_boundary: incremental transport net benefit; fixed existing overhead excluded as a common constant; no claim of full accounting profit

temperature.source_role: constant-temperature laboratory reference from tomato and mullet studies
temperature.product_equals_cabin_temperature: explicit ideal-isothermal assumption, no heat-transfer lag or door transient simulation
temperature.tomato_acceptance_claim: not established; TA is an indicator, not a validated saleability or safety test

refrigeration_cost_scenario.source: pinned author VRPTWQ README Refrigeration table, numerical parameters
refrigeration_cost_scenario.role: simplified steady wall-leak numerical cost using published benchmark coefficient; not the author complete VRPTWQ quality/energy model

tomato.purchase_role: paper explicitly assumes80% of sale price;3.60 derived, not empirical procurement quote
tomato.value_mapping_role: NEW explicit modeling hypothesis borrowing a linear grade-value shape; neither cited paper experimentally calibrates TA-to-price
tomato.grade_value_precedent: Li2018 thesis Chapter6 Table6.1, PDF p114, https://www.biblio.univ-evry.fr/theses/2018/2018SACLE036.pdf
tomato.rho_center_derivation: midpoint U[4,7] / midpoint U[10,20] =5.5/15; deterministic scenario, no random parameter sampling

rho_sensitivity.name: flat_price_control
rho_sensitivity.derivation: no quality discount control; revenue constant

mullet_quality_counterfactual.role: same-route single-product quality counterfactual; no mixed-product demands or monetary value assigned
mullet_quality_counterfactual.initial_role: Figure6(c) approximate graph initial, not exact fitted intercept or current-batch measurement

accounting.no_double_count_loss: quality discount reduces revenue; do not also subtract the same loss as spoilage cost
accounting.normalization_rule: divide every monetary total by4.5EUR; ranking unchanged; not a currency exchange

limits: This is a composite numerical hypothesis, not replication of any one paper and not author VRPTWQ algorithm reproduction.
Only original customer files; structurally impossible customer windows cause instance exclusion with proof, never repair.
Tomato TA-to-value is a declared unvalidated hypothesis and tomato marketability threshold remains unconfigured.
Refrigeration is a steady thermal cost proxy, not measured compressor electricity or a vehicle energy digital twin.
Mullet monetary profit is not computed; its sensory threshold is checked only for the same-route counterfactual.
No claim of MaskCO method gain, real profit prediction, formal statistical significance, or regulatory compliance.
